### What does this PR do?

Prevents the edit tool from applying destructive replacements when the model provides unsafe or overly vague match text.

- Rejects `oldString: ""` when the target file already exists, while keeping empty `oldString` available for creating new files.
- Tightens block-anchor fallback matching so first/last-line anchors cannot silently match a much larger block.
- Adds a disproportionate-match guard that refuses replacements where the matched span is much larger than the requested `oldString`.
- Returns actionable guidance so the model can re-read the file and provide exact replacement text instead of guessing.

### Why

The edit tool could previously treat an empty `oldString` as a full-file overwrite, or use loose multiline anchors to replace a broad span between matching boundary lines. Both paths can silently delete large portions of a file.
title: fix(opencode): prevent destructive edit matches
